_about: Facts and defaults for content-publisher. Each fact carries a confidence level like platform.json: high = stated plainly in Meta's docs, medium = implied or partly stated, verify = Meta's own pages disagree or it changes often. Checked against Meta's docs on 2026-11-11.

host.note: Instagram API with Instagram Login (Business Login for Instagram), scopes instagram_business_basic + instagram_business_content_publish. Set IG_API_HOST=graph.facebook.com for the Facebook Login path.

version.note: Version used in Meta's content-publishing examples on 2026-11-11. Override with IG_API_VERSION when Meta retires it.

carousel_max_items.note: 'up to 20 images, videos, or a combination of the two'.

carousel_min_items.note: Meta's docs do not state a minimum; one item is an image post, not a carousel.

posts_per_24h.note: Meta's guide says 100 API-published posts per 24-hour moving period; the media_publish reference says 50. The tool reads the live quota (content_publishing_limit) instead of trusting either number.

image_extensions.note: 'JPEG is the only image format supported. Extended JPEG formats such as MPO and JPS are not supported.'

video_extensions.note: Common reel formats; exact video specs are on Meta's media reference.

container_expiry_hours.note: Containers not published within 24 hours expire.

alt_text.note: alt_text was added for image posts (March 2025); reels and stories are not supported. Not sent for carousel items to avoid a failed publish.

polling.note: Meta recommends checking a container's status once per minute for no more than 5 minutes.
